$comment: GENERATED by `npm run routes:emit` from inbound/src/routes.ts. Do not edit by hand:
inbound/route-table.test.ts fails when this file and the source disagree.
The PARAMETER layer of the contract (#417), the sibling of api-routes.json, keyed
by the same route id so the two join and neither repeats the other. It answers
'what may a caller SEND to this route', which is the half the published clients
actually drifted on: a filter the worker honors that no client can express, and a
name a client sends that the worker never reads, are both invisible to a suite
that mocks its own idea of the worker.
Every claim here is proved against the REAL handler in inbound/route-params.test.ts:
a declared query parameter must be strictly REFUSED when bogus or demonstrably
CHANGE the answer, so this file cannot describe a worker that does not exist.
query: query-string names the route reads. body: top-level JSON keys; 'set.x' names
a nested key. A route with no entry here takes neither.

send.note: attachments are base64 over JSON (#70); forwardMessageId quotes a stored message, recipients stay caller-selected

send-alias.note: back-compat alias of /api/send: the same handler, so deliberately the same list

reply.note: mode reply|replyAll derives the original recipients server-side (#363)

messages-seen.note: `for` writes a per-recipient override; under a session it must be the session identity (#410)

messages-move.note: mailbox archive|trash|junk, or null to restore the direction-default view

drafts.note: list/create/update/delete/send plus draft attachments. Identity-owned: a static operator token gets E_IDENTITY_REQUIRED. PUT on an EXISTING draft requires its current updatedAt; an absent one is a conflict too, so an edit is read-modify-write

imap-drafts.note: the door has no ambient identity, so it asserts the already-authenticated one on every call

admin-reconcile.note: read-only report, gated admin because it spans the whole estate

messages-list.note: lens needs a viewer and refuses direction (#403); under a session to= filters INSIDE the account boundary (#422); seenFor moves only the read-state projection key (#404)

search.note: mode fts|substr|semantic|hybrid; field pairs with substr; the view filters mirror messages-list exactly because they share one builder

recipients-recent.note: a bound identity wins; an unbound BYO token must name viewer= or to=, never an estate dump

folders.note: to= scopes the unread counts; a bound identity wins over it server-side
